fixes.explanation: That one's True, friend. Peter writes that if you possess these qualities and continue to grow in them, “…they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.” The card just says it back to you, so there's no trap in it. I once squinted at a plain bowl of dough for ten minutes looking for a trick, and it was just dough. Sometimes the straight answer is the whole answer.

Peter doesn't say life gets easier. What he says is, “…if you practice these things you will never stumble…” Never stumbling and having an easy road aren't the same thing, friend. A baker can cross a bumpy kitchen floor and still not drop the tray. I'd take steady feet over a smooth floor any day.
